node_log.detail: {"note": "Finance keeps asking for the sales report as JSON so they can pipe it into their own thing. Please make render(rows, \"json\") in app/report.py give JSON, coming out of render like every other format does, because everything downstream calls render; no new module, and no second way out of that module. It should be a list with one object per data row, with the keys region, units and revenue, in the same order as the text report, and no TOTAL object: the text report's TOTAL line is there for a human, finance sums their own columns, and a fake row in a data feed is how things get double-counted. The text report must stay exactly as it is, down to the whitespace, because three teams have scripts that grep it. Only change app/report.py; a new test file, tests/test_report_json.py, is welcome.
